description: This file is a build configuration script for package management in OpenWrt, defining functions and build rules for creating and managing packages (ipkg and apk). It includes dependency checks, package metadata, and build steps.

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for package files based on package name and ABI version.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes specified ipkg or apk package files for a given package.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines build variables and commands for package components, including scripts and metadata.

methods.name: dep_split
methods.description: Splits dependency strings into components based on colon separator.

methods.name: dep_rem
methods.description: Removes parentheses and negation symbols from dependency strings.

methods.name: dep_and
methods.description: Evaluates logical AND of configuration conditions.

methods.name: dep_confvar
methods.description: Constructs configuration variable expressions based on dependencies.

methods.name: dep_if
methods.description: Determines dependency condition based on negation.

methods.name: strip_deps
methods.description: Removes plus signs and filters dependencies.

methods.name: AddDependency
methods.description: Adds dependencies to package build rules.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies for a package.
